pattern: epic breakdown recommends own branch and marks briefs as planned

rule: An epic breakdown whose children still need planning: recommend autoBuild false and 'inherit', with those children planned: false.

pattern: plan proposed with no decision log
experience: A planning interview ended in a proposed plan, and nothing recorded which questions the user answered and which the agent settled itself, so the Summary pane had no decision log and child cards had nothing to inherit.
rule: Record every decision with board_record_decisions before board_propose_plans, flagging calls you were unsure of as unclear.

pattern: auto-plan steering answered with another question
experience: A human clicked Auto-plan → Build mid-interview and the planning agent asked its open question again instead of deciding it, so the card never left planning.
rule: On an auto-plan turn: decide every remaining question, record each decision, propose the plan and complete the step, with no more questions.
